title: Glass Vanity Shelf With Integrated Towel Bar, 16-Inch Solid Brass Wall Mount | Unlacquered Brass | Waverly Place Collection | Allied Brass
body_html:
Clear counter clutter and keep towels right where you need them with a wall-mounted glass shelf that adds storage at the vanity without taking up surface space in Unlacquered Brass, which is a living finish that develops a unique natural patina over time, gaining character and warmth with age. Each piece becomes one-of-a-kind, perfect for those who appreciate authentic materials that tell a story.

  • Unlacquered Brass develops a unique, one-of-a-kind patina over time
  • Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
  • Rely on enduring hardware crafted from solid brass materials for secure wall-mount support.
  • Create a coordinated look with the Waverly Place collection for matching Waverly Place accessories and versatile bath accessories.

Specs & Installation

  • Glass dimensions: 16 x 5 inches
  • Glass thickness: 3/8 inch (0.38 in)
  • Projection: 5 inches
  • Weight capacity: 2 lb
  • Mounting: wall mount (installation hardware included)
  • Assembly required: No
  • Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
